integrity: The all-degree claim is reduced mathematically to finitely many residue-and-boundary signatures and the proof-critical rank calculation is reproduced by an exact modular-arithmetic checker. No independence claim is made.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is proved only in dimension three and only for the exact homogeneous divergence-free recursion; it does not settle the small-characteristic higher-dimensional problem.
title: Restricted-source exactness in three variables in characteristics \(2\) and \(3\)
